answer: Under convex-tenure licensing, every agent must mint a non-transferable relic by completing sequential epochs of externally judged compute, emitting one cryptographic pulse per finished audit. Market routing weight scales with the cube of an identity's unbroken pulse count, while any unfulfilled gale of disputed tasks burns the entire relic. Splitting one operator's hardware across $k$ clones divides each clone's pulse rate by $k$ and cuts total weight to $1/k^2$, so matching one honest agent across $k$ sybils requires paying for $k$ parallel streams of dedicated, non-colluding client audits.
